replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
> No wood, iron, and it's completely flat.

Limited resources for armor are a feature. I wanted the map balanced and removing the chance to spawn camp with semi-OP gear was a bit step towards that. As for wood, I didn't want players to be able to craft a lot of things that could make the game stalemate (and by stalemate i mean hours not the 20minute matches you are complaining about) like crafting tables.

> It probably took 10 minutes to make and is a stalemate every time

20 minutes isn't a stalemate. Its a good lenght for a match so the match can fully develop and shine. Clay Wars isn't the greatest showcase of a map fully developing it self in 20 minutes but I'd rather see a 20 minute match and have that develop than a 5 minute match that is just players rushing and dying all over again.

As for the 10 minutes to make. The building and aesthetics didn't take much time but balancing the map to have balanced gameplay, prevent some things such as spawn camping and having nicely developed matches with good lenght can take quite some time. The map was alsp playtested privately (on one of my friends server) and went through 2 big updates before being released to make sure the gameplay is balanced and the matches have a good lenght.

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Having no wood or iron doesn't mean it lacks creativity. On the contrary, really. It means that players have to adapt their game-play style to make up for the lack of iron and wood. 

As to your point about it being a stalemate every time, I disagree. Every time I have played the map, it has always been long, that much is true. However, I have rarely ever seen a stalemate. There is always one team pushing and the other team is trying to defend. That makes it far more exciting, in my opinion.

I respect your opinion, but it's not exactly nice to label a project that someone has put hard work and thought into as "sh*t".
